title: The constant-true function is low degree
statement: For every $n$ and every degree bound $d$, the constant function $\mathbf{1} : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ taking the value $1$ at every point lies in the Reed--Muller code $\mathrm{RM}(d, n)$; that is, it has degree $\le d$.
hypotheses_covered: holds for every degree bound d
replaced:
The constant-true function $\mathbf{1} : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ belongs to
$\mathrm{RM}(d, n)$ for every $d$.
